title: Lipschitz stability of uniform expectation
statement:
Let $n\in\mathbb N$ and let $f,g:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$. If $\psi:\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$ is $c$-Lipschitz for some $c\ge0$, then
\[
\left|\E[\psi\circ f]-\E[\psi\circ g]\right|\le c\,\|f-g\|_2,
\]
where expectation and the $L^2$ norm are taken with respect to the uniform measure on the Boolean cube.
hypotheses_covered: A function $\psi:\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$ that is $c$-Lipschitz for some $c\ge0$
